SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   D. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

8. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   C. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

   C. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat School and Community as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
